_readme: LICENSING: every URL here is from Unsplash, whose licence allows free
commercial use without attribution. They are NOT taken from Google image
results — most of those are copyrighted (other restaurants, food bloggers,
stock agencies) and putting them on a paying client's website invites a
takedown or a claim against the client.
THESE ARE STAND-INS. They show the right kind of dish, not PKS's own food.
Before the site goes public the client should either approve them as
stand-ins or replace them with real photographs of their kitchen.
TO REPLACE ONE: change the `url` to a local path like /photos/food/karahi.jpg
and drop the file in public/photos/food/. Nothing else needs to change.
The `credit` field is not required by the licence but is good manners and
makes it obvious later which images are still stand-ins.
